claimText: IIIT Tiruchirappalli is a public-private-partnership technology institute at Sethurapatti in Tamil Nadu. Its current admissions pages list four B.Tech. routes and two M.Tech. programmes, alongside doctoral research areas. Applicants need to distinguish central counselling, DASA and institute-run self-support admissions.
Government Gazette notification of 22 October 2018 publishes statutes for the exact IIIT Tiruchirappalli entity under the IIIT PPP Act 2017.

claimText: The official About page names TCS, Cognizant, Infosys, Ramco, ELCOT and Navitas as industry partners.

The institute has operated from its permanent Sethurapatti campus since June 2021. Its hostel page lists residence halls, a mess hall and a gym. The campus is on the Trichy–Madurai highway rather than at the former NIT or Oxford Engineering College locations.

The institute publishes a hostel accommodation form and separate hostel-and-mess charges for the 2026–27 first semester. Residence rules set permissions and return-time requirements. Confirm room allocation and the latest rules with the hostel office before arranging accommodation.

A campus mess is listed, and the first-semester schedules include mess advance charges. The reviewed sources do not establish allergy handling or specific dietary accommodation; students should check those needs with the hostel office.

Published hostel regulations prohibit ragging and direct residents to report incidents. They also provide for emergency contact information at room allotment. These policies are not a guarantee of safety or a substitute for checking current reporting contacts.

Lok Sabha answer of 28 November 2016 lists IIIT Tiruchirappalli among institutions established in 2013, with academic commencement 2013–14.

The permanent campus is at Sethurapatti on the Tiruchirappalli–Madurai highway in Tamil Nadu. The institute’s 2026 reporting guide places it about 20 kilometres from Tiruchirappalli Junction and the central bus stand. Travel planning should use this campus, not its former NIT or Oxford Engineering College locations.

IIIT Tiruchirappalli describes an agreement with SVNIT Surat covering joint research, academic activities and innovation. Its stated scope includes internship opportunities for B.Tech. and M.Tech. students and collaborative projects. These are opportunities within the collaboration, not a guarantee of an internship, placement or supervisor allocation for every student.

The 2026 DASA B.Tech. route requires JEE Main Paper 1, the prescribed nationality/overseas-schooling category, birth on or after 1 October 2001, Class XII Mathematics and Physics plus a listed third subject, and 75% across five subjects or CGPA 7.5/10. The revised matrix separately confirms this exact IIIT branch. These are historical 2026 conditions, not a 2027 eligibility promise.
